The preliminary proposal assumes we'd finance 90% of eligible invoices with standard supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I make any binding decision on whether this launches and on what terms, I need to run our normal pre-launch procedure: a round-robin review with credit risk, legal, and finance operations. I'd like to hear from each of you in turn. Could credit risk start us off with your assessment of this facility?
